3.text: the Asiatic Eskimo, and the American Eskimo of Alaska. Whaling-crews

4.text: and miners use them in preference to the civilized form of foot-gear. In Asia

5.text: they are traded off to the inland camps of Reindeer people, and some of

6.text: them reach even the market-places of the Kolyma. Some of the seal-skin

7.text: boots are much longer. Boots and trousers combined, made of curried seal-

8.text: skin, are occasionally seen. These are useful for seal-hunters and fishermen,

9.text: who walk constantly through cold water.
